svg.aria-label: Portfolio AI architecture: the chat UI sends a request through Supabase Edge auth and rate limiting to the portfolio-ai coordinator agent, which for Groq picks a model via keyword routing or switches to Claude Sonnet 5 entirely once an Anthropic key is set, calls MCP tools over JSON-RPC against portfolio-mcp-server, which runs SQL against Postgres under RLS, and streams a token response back over SSE. Dashboard pages query Postgres directly via usePortfolio, bypassing the agent and MCP hop. Below, a separate on-demand data-ingestion pipeline of six edge functions pulls prices, FX rates and fundamentals from Yahoo Finance (with a Frankfurter/open.er-api.com fallback chain for FX) into the same Postgres tables.
svg.text: escalates simple→complex if a "simple" turn needs too many tool calls
env-var switch: exclusive once ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set — not per-query routing
cross-cutting — every gate + the tool loop log here, it isn't part of the agent loop
Data ingestion — on-demand, browser-triggered, no cron
PriceRefreshButton · auto-refresh on homepage load · Benchmark / Reports / RollingReturns / Updates pages — each fetch-* function independently gates on auth.ts requireUser
returned straight to the caller, not persisted
